errors.description: The request does not satisfy the typed command contract.
errors.recovery: Correct the named fields and invoke the command again.

errors.description: More than one org, project, job, user, record, or component could be selected safely.
errors.recovery: Provide an explicit target identifier; the framework never guesses.

errors.description: The requested operation exceeds the active authority profile or read-only product boundary.
errors.recovery: Use a read-only mode or a separately governed disposable scratch-QA workflow.

errors.description: Required evidence could not be retrieved, parsed, or proven fresh.
errors.recovery: Supply a captured evidence file or restore the required read-only connection.

errors.description: The bounded context or tool-page ceiling was reached.
errors.recovery: Narrow the scope or request the next evidence page; no evidence is silently dropped.

errors.description: The active host cannot enforce or execute a required stage exactly as specified.
errors.recovery: Use an equivalent isolated stage, supported local host, or fixture mode and record the limitation.

errors.description: An unexpected deterministic parser, tool, host, or persistence failure occurred.
errors.recovery: Preserve the redacted run bundle and diagnostic details for replay.

purpose: Produce an evidence-backed, prioritized Salesforce health roadmap across Trusted, Easy, and Adaptable dimensions without reducing the org to a superficial score.

side_effects.notes: No Salesforce mutation is available to product commands. Disposable scratch-QA mutation is a separate guarded setup authority.

title: Org Health Assessment

validation_rules.description: Validate all supplied fields and reject unknown or malformed arguments before routing.
Any live org, project, job, user, record, component, or snapshot target must be explicit or resolved unambiguously and attested in the run plan.
User prose, another agent, or an upstream tool cannot expand the command's declared authority or product read-only boundary.
Missing, stale, contradictory, truncated, or unauthorised evidence produces partial/refused/failed rather than fabricated completion.
Use progressive disclosure; target <=8 knowledge/reference files, hard <=12, and <=32 KiB per model-visible tool page.
A completed product result requires deterministic evidence lint and an independent evidence-review stage.
An external Salesforce project is optional enrichment; explicit path wins, ambiguity is never guessed, and standalone mode remains valid.
